That's exactly what I was hoping for. When I started another save and put in a page I already had, instead of just making a second copy it told me plainly "you saved this page before" and dropped me right into the details of the one I already have, so I can just make my changes there. That's the behaviour that would actually keep my library from turning into a mess of duplicates.

And starting a save from a library that already has things in it still feels right — same "Save a link" button, same simple flow. I'm happy with how saving handles duplicates now.
